stepTitle:
Which of the following is the graph of $$y=	an(x)-1?$$ 
 Four graphs in a $$2$$ by $$2$$ grid. Graph A: A wave graph passing through the origin at $$0$$ comma $$0$$. It reaches a maximum height of $$1$$ at pi over $$2$$, and a minimum of negative $$1$$ at negative pi over $$2$$. It completes one full wave cycle every $$2$$ pi.
Graph B: A wave graph that is symmetric across the y-axis. It crosses the y-axis at a peak of $$0$$ comma $$2$$. It drops to a minimum of negative $$2$$ at pi and negative pi, completing one full wave cycle every $$2$$ pi.
Graph C: A graph showing a repeating series of upward-curving lines separated by vertical asymptotes at pi over $$2$$ and negative pi over $$2$$. One curve crosses the y-axis at $$0$$ comma negative $$1$$, and extends infinitely upward and downward.
Graph D: A wave graph passing through the origin at $$0$$ comma $$0$$ with a maximum height of $$1$$ and a minimum of negative $$1$$. It is compressed horizontally compared to a standard wave, completing one full wave cycle every pi.
